The [[Gesshoku]] are a pair of [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] that [[Miku]] is initially equipped with when she joins the player's party as a hero.

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +10% (while in a [[Stance]])
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Armor]] +5
:Damage +20%
:[[Customize]]d for <[[character]] name>
